name: CAD Digital
oneLiner: CADD is Tetra Trust's regulated Canadian dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against CAD held in trust under Alberta's Loan and Trust Corporations Act.
collateral: Canadian dollar reserves held 1:1 in trust for token holders by Tetra Trust

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540162 and Base block 48677278, canonical proxy 0x16f93ebc5320c89efc8701577efe49d14a276a06 resolves to the full-match verified ERC20F implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62. Current hasRole reads confirm 0x47a5059be8e1876346f4b854377baaa3c0e0d4eb holds PAUSER_ROLE on both chains. Its pause() function is PAUSER_ROLE-gated and every token transfer passes whenNotPaused; transfer and transferFrom also query the active nonzero access registry for both sender and receiver, while recoverTokens can transfer from an account without access. Direct global and holder-level transfer control therefore exists.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: CADD uses ERC20F with role-gated minting and UUPS upgrades. Ethereum and Base share the same implementation and EIP-7702 delegated role holders: minter 0x4b37dd8b, default admin 0xb3a77dd7, and upgrader 0x9367b51c. All three delegate to Fireblocks' verified UniversalGaslessDelegate; the off-chain signer custody policy remains undisclosed.

controls.label: CADD MINTER_ROLE holder (ETH and Base)
controls.evidence: RoleGranted logs on both ETH and Base confirm this address holds MINTER_ROLE (0x9f2df0fed...). eth_getCode on both chains returns 0xef0100 || 0x0000fb7702036ff9f76044a501ac1aa74cbab16b, the EIP-7702 delegation indicator for Fireblocks' verified UniversalGaslessDelegate. The delegate validates signatures but does not disclose the private-key custody policy behind this role holder.

controls.label: CADD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder (ETH and Base)
controls.evidence: RoleGranted logs on ETH and Base confirm DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by this address. eth_getCode returns the same Fireblocks UniversalGaslessDelegate indicator on both chains. The verified implementation assigns upgrades to a distinct UPGRADER_ROLE rather than DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.label: CADD UPGRADER_ROLE holder (ETH and Base)
controls.evidence: The verified ERC20F implementation gates _authorizeUpgrade() with UPGRADER_ROLE 0x189ab7a9.... RoleGranted history and current hasRole calls identify 0x9367b51c... as the holder on both Ethereum and Base. Both proxies resolve to implementation 0x0f25045d.... The upgrader account delegates to Fireblocks UniversalGaslessDelegate; no timelock is present and the underlying signer custody remains undisclosed.

review.evidence: Ethereum and Base share the same UUPS implementation and role graph. Current calls confirm 0x4b37dd8b holds MINTER_ROLE, 0xb3a77dd7 holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and 0x9367b51c holds UPGRADER_ROLE on both chains. EIP-7702 code identifies Fireblocks UniversalGaslessDelegate as the common delegate implementation. That resolves the on-chain delegate and upgrade authority, but not the signer custody policy behind any of the three delegated EOAs, so confidence remains manual-review. The registry records Alberta Treasury Board and Finance under Alberta's Loan and Trust Corporations Act as the named prudential regulator. The Fireblocks/EIP-7702 signer custody-policy opacity is a custody-quality caveat, not a control-identity gap; it does not block a scoreable deployment-control review.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: CAD Digital/Tetra announced CADD as a regulated CAD stablecoin live on Base, Ethereum, and Tempo with Solana planned. No separate bridge protocol is documented in issuer materials, so the reviewed route is issuer-native multichain issuance. 2026-07-20 cohort dc-1 pass: Ethereum row confirmed native CADD; Base row confirmed via uniform proxy implementation fingerprint.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Kimi P2 control cohort dc-1 (lead usdt-tether)

routes.protocol: CADD (CAD Digital native issuance on Ethereum)
routes.reviewNote: Verified on-chain 2026-07-20: name 'CAD Digital Inc', symbol CADD, 18 decimals — issuer-native deployment on Ethereum.

routes.protocol: CADD issuer multichain deployment (uniform proxy implementation)
routes.reviewNote: Verified on-chain 2026-07-20: uniform deployment address on Base with EIP-1967 implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62 — byte-identical to the verified Ethereum CADD implementation; name()/symbol() reads returned empty via the Base public RPC on 2026-07-20, so identity rests on the uniform proxy fingerprint plus the mint-authority review's shared ETH/Base role holders. The token contract executes mint.
